title: Wallbox Charger Session Daily Event Volume
dataSources: Tesla vehicle/charge state (`tesla:vehicle`, `tesla:charge`), TeslaMate MQTT/Postgres, OBD-II PIDs (`obd:pid`), Smartcar API (`smartcar:vehicle`), EV charger sessions (`evcharger:session`).
app: Tesla Fleet API / TeslaMate, Teslafi, and generic OBD-II / Smartcar / manufacturer APIs via HEC scripted inputs and MQTT.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=wallbox:session
| bin _time span=1d
| stats count as events, dc(charger_id) as distinct_entities by _time
| sort - _time
description: Counts how many Wallbox charger session events land each day and how many distinct charger values are represented.
value: Daily volume is the fastest way to spot a dead feed, a sudden burst, or a workflow that quietly changed.
implementation: Ingest Wallbox charger session records into `index=personal`; schedule daily and compare count and distinct charger values against your normal baseline.
visualization: Column chart of daily event count with a line for distinct entities.
grandmaExplanation: It follows how much Wallbox charger session activity showed up each day so you can see if the feed went quiet or suddenly got busy.
